attack_params.checkpoint_selection: per-sample maximum sum of clean raw patch-score population standard deviation and absolute mean, each divided by its layer maximum; drop before peak block

checkpoint_score_normalization.scope: per clean image across all candidate blocks
checkpoint_score_normalization.standard_deviation: divide by maximum candidate population standard deviation
checkpoint_score_normalization.absolute_mean: divide by maximum candidate absolute signed mean

attack_params.checkpoint_tie_break: earliest block in native forward order
attack_params.drop_count_rounding: total ratio rounded to 12 decimals; max(1, round(native token count * ratio))
